notes: GAAP; governmental funds from Total Governmental Funds columns (pp6-7); beginning fund balance is as originally reported (2,834,973) with the (58,569) restatement as an adjustment (restated 2,776,404). ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents on governmental funds balance sheet (p5; certificates of deposit 270,332 and county treasurer cash 58,448 are separate lines). Business-type: total enterprise funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p11): receipts = operating revenues + interest income, grant income, city sales tax; disbursements = operating expenses + interest expense + loss from joint venture (printed as negative nonoperating item, recorded as an expense); no single total printed so totals were added. Net position beginning is as originally reported 9,499,527, restatement +58,569 as adjustment; transfers net (100,000) offset the governmental +100,000. Internal service fund excluded. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, governmental and business-type activities columns (each line tagged by fund type); the due from/(to) other funds lines (-73,151 governmental, +73,151 business-type) are recorded as Internal Balances and net to zero, so totals are unaffected; current portion of TIF and noncurrent TIF are shown only for the component unit. Detail: General Fund detail recorded from the General Fund Departments combining schedule (p20-21; revenue from the Total column, expenditures by department) and the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p14) was NOT recorded to avoid double counting (its function-level amounts are budgetary basis and differ). CDBG budgetary schedule (p17) has no actual amounts and was skipped. Street and LB840 detail from budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis, so totals differ slightly from the GAAP statements). Keno and Public Benefit funds had no activity. Cemetery department (p21, 9,525) is categorized health/welfare per the category rules, although the p6 statement includes it in General Fund Public works. Attempt 3 (2026-10-28 verifier fixes): business-type Sales 4,709,108 (p11) recategorized to Utility Charges; Street Fund capital outlay 87,500 (p15) relabelled 'Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways' (printed text in printed_label); balance-sheet note on internal balances corrected. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
